item.title: Thunderstorm Advisory No. 5 #SLPRSD
item.description:
Thunderstorm Advisory No. 5 #SLPRSD
Issued at 02:00 PM 10 September 2026

Moderate to heavy rainshowers with lightning and strong winds are being experienced in #CamarinesNorte(SantaElena, Capalonga), #Masbate(CityOfMasbate, Baleno), #NorthernSamar(Bobon, Catarman, SanJose, Rosario, Victoria, SanIsidro, Lavezares, Allen, Biri, Palapag, Mapanas, Gamay, Lapinig, Laoang), #OrientalMindoro(Bulalacao and Mansalay) which may persist within 1 to 2 hours and may affect nearby areas.

All are advised to take precautionary measures against the impacts associated with these hazards which include flash floods and landslides.

Keep monitoring for updates.
